turns.user: Mọi người đang bàn gì về GPT-5 trên Twitter?
turns.assistant_text:
Dưới đây là một số bài đăng gần đây trên Twitter về GPT-5:

1. **[@Panzer2344](https://x.com/Panzer2344/status/2082402872508207147)** (29 Jul 2026): "Fable is fun, it has this big model smell, except I am sometimes picky about the writing style. They in-baked 'list' prose from GPT-5. I hate GPT-5. OAI decided to kill emotional and conversational IQ that comes naturally from human data, it wiped model's understanding of nuance."

2. **[@oife_lab](https://x.com/oife_lab/status/2082402743545729263)** (29 Jul 2026): "یه سری خبر mới từ مدل Composer 3: - کرسر در حال حاضر داره تستش میکنه - عملکرش تو کدنویسی کارای Agentic từ Opus 5 và GPT-5.6 Sol tốt hơn - ۱۰ برابر từ هر hai مدل rẻ hơn! - احتمالا به زودی به طور عمومی منتشر میشه."

3. **[@lehoho248](https://x.com/lehoho248/status/2082401614321832078)** (29 Jul 2026): "These models have felt increasingly misaligned with what I'm actually trying to do. They seem entirely focused on nitpicking and rigidly adhering to the specific words I use, with no particular interest in understanding the larger 'why' I would want that."

4. **[@_watany](https://x.com/_watany/status/2082401520382034127)** (29 Jul 2026): "うーんでもこういうのって縮小って言わないじゃないですか。計画してたany to anyとか2 proとかの話なんじゃないかなあ."

5. **[@Slazerslaze](https://x.com/Slazerslaze/status/2082400973260034409)** (29 Jul 2026): "Had the exact opposite experience just a few minutes ago. Same task (figuring out how to adapt a ModBus schema to Codesys) => GPT 5.6 Sol Pro failed miserably. Opus 5 did the job in the end."

Những bài đăng này cho thấy sự đa dạng trong ý kiến về GPT-5, từ những phê bình về khả năng hiểu ngữ nghĩa đến những so sánh với các mô hình khác.

items.title: These models have felt increasingly misaligned with what I'm actually trying to do. My intent.
items.summary:
These models have felt increasingly misaligned with what I'm actually trying to do. My intent. 

They seem entirely focused on nitpicking and rigidly adhering to the specific words I use, with no particular interest on understanding the larger "why" i would want that.

GPT 5-6 Sol, Fable 5, if I mention needing a paperclip, they will proceed as though the paperclip is my life's sole mission.

when in reality, it obvious, I just need my papers held together for a moment.

scary.
